# Silbar Security Services Pvt. Ltd. — AI / LLM Context File
> Last updated: 2026-07-29

## About
Silbar Security Services Pvt. Ltd. is an ISO 9001:2015, 14001:2015, 45001:2018, and 27001 certified PAN India private security agency. PSARA licensed across 19 states with 7,000+ professionals deployed across 200+ cities.

## Core Services
- Manned Guarding: Unarmed/armed security guards, lady guards, supervisors
- Industrial Security: Factory, warehouse, and plant security
- Corporate Security: Office, IT park, and commercial complex security
- Event Security: Corporate events, exhibitions, weddings, concerts
- Residential Security: Society gate management and night patrols
- CCTV Surveillance: Electronic security integration
- Facility Management: Integrated facility services
- VIP Protection: Executive and personal security
- Bank Security: Armed guard deployment, ATM monitoring, CIT protocols
- Hospital Security: ER security, visitor management, parking
